privacy.ai_training_note: Phenom explicitly avoids training on demographic or biometric data. Uses 'job-relevant variables' and applies 'science-based practices from industrial organizational psychology, machine learning, and statistics.' Fit Score undergoes annual independent audits confirming fairness with 'no adverse impact or bias detected.' Does not share candidate PII with third parties unless contractually required.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly specified; company states data may be transferred to countries other than origin; complies with EU-U.S. DPF and UK Extension. Specifics available upon request to sales.

security.name: Data encryption in transit

security.name: Data encryption at rest

security.name: Data destruction
security.value: Data destruction follows DoD 5220.22-M or NIST 800-88 guidelines

security.name: Authentication
security.value: SSH key-based authentication (not passwords); MFA required minimum three times for data center access

security.name: Access control

security.name: Application security testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration testing; quarterly DAST/SAST scanning; internal testing

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on AWS secure data centers with firewall security groups, automatic fire detection/suppression, fully redundant electrical power with UPS backup, 24/7 monitoring

security.name: Disaster recovery & business continuity
